text.p: Following is a summary of major Shanghai political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Shanghai stock markets rose in heavy volume last week.
- Commentary says China's stock markets will rise steadily this year on the back of the improved national economy.
- A seminar which ended in Beijing on Sunday urges banks and other financial institutions to give more support to mergers and bankruptcies of money-lossing state enterprices.

- BUSINESS NEWS - The annual session of the Shanghai People's Congress, the local parliament, closed on Sunday and adopted plans for Shanghai's development in 1997. Editorial hails Shanghai's economic development as healthy.
